Familiarity with agentic AI development using LangGraph for multi-step reasoning and tool orchestration.

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and ML services.

descriptionFromApi:
About the Role
We are looking for two highly motivated and hands-on Robotics AI Interns to join our research and development team. In this role, you will work at the cutting edge of physical AI, developing advanced software pipelines that enable intelligent systems to perceive their environments with high fidelity and execute complex, autonomous tasks.
This internship is designed for individuals who want to bridge the gap between state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms, modern deep learning architectures, and physical (or simulated) robotic platforms.
Core Responsibilities
You will collaborate with our engineering team to develop, test, and deploy software across our perception and autonomy stacks:
  • Advanced Perception Spatial Computing : Design and implement robust algorithms for environment reconstruction, scene understanding, and sensor processing. You will manipulate real-time data from depth sensors (RGB-D, LiDAR) to create spatial awareness for our platforms.
  • Embodied AI Intelligent Control : Develop, train, and deploy advanced learning-based policies for robotic systems. You will focus on multi-modal intelligence, enabling agents to translate complex sensory inputs into precise autonomous actions.
  • Simulation Physical Deployment : Build, configure, and utilize simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, PyBullet) to train and validate perception and control pipelines before deploying code onto hardware.
  • Systems Integration: Benchmark, optimize, and integrate deep learning models with classic robotics frameworks to ensure real-time, low-latency performance.
Technical Requirements
  • Education: Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Computer Vision 3D Processing: Strong hands-on experience with OpenCV for image processing and PCL (Point Cloud Library) or Open3D for point cloud filtering, segmentation, and registration. Solid grasp of 3D geometry and coordinate transformations.
  • Deep Learning AI: Deep understanding of Neural Networks, with specific technical expertise in Transformer architectures, multi-modal models (Vision-Language), and attention mechanisms.
  • Software Engineering: High proficiency in Python and/or C++, with strong clean-coding practices, Git version control, and comfort working within Linux/Ubuntu environments.
  • Robotics Frameworks: Experience or familiarity with ROS/ROS2, imitation learning, behavioral cloning, or reinforcement learning applied to autonomous systems.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working directly with physical robotic hardware or deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with generative AI, diffusion models, or open-source foundation models.
  • Active contributions to open-source robotics, computer vision, or AI projects on GitHub.

About the Team
Global Central Operations is a key function supporting Corporate Solutions operations across APAC. The Credit Control team plays an important role in maintaining the financial health of the portfolio by supporting timely cash allocation, follow-up of outstanding balances, reconciliation activities, query management, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Role Overview
The Apprentice will support the Credit Control team with routine operational, reconciliation, tracking, and reporting activities. This role is suitable for a fresh graduate who is eager to build foundational knowledge in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance accounting, cash management, and stakeholder communication within a structured corporate environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Support tracking of cash application, premium allocation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Assist in monitoring unpaired cash, unsettled balances, and outstanding premium items.
  • Support follow-up activities with brokers, clients, internal teams, and outsourcing partners under guidance from the team.
  • Maintain and update operational trackers such as query trackers, broker follow-up trackers, reconciliation trackers, and audit support logs.
  • Assist in preparing data for governance reviews, dashboards, KPI monitoring, and monthly reporting.
  • Support data validation, document collection, evidence preparation, and audit related activities.
  • Help with query screening, follow-ups, and coordination to ensure timely closure of open items.
  • Learn and support basic Credit Control processes including incoming payments, outgoing payments, manual pairing, and settlement follow-ups.
  • Assist in maintaining process documentation, SOP updates, and control evidence where required.
  • Participate in team meetings, process training, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What You Will Learn
  • Foundational understanding of Credit Control and cash management processes.
  • Exposure to insurance and reinsurance finance operations in a global environment.
  • Practical experience in reconciliation, reporting, data validation, and operational controls.
  • Understanding of stakeholder communication, follow-up discipline, and service delivery standards.
  • Experience working with internal teams, brokers, clients, and outsourcing partners.
  • Awareness of audit readiness, process documentation, and control requirements.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • B.Com, BBA, or equivalent undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
  • Basic understanding of accounting concepts and financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of MS Excel; exposure to PowerPoint and Word will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent business communication and cross-cultural skills, both verbal and written. Ability to adapt and learn in a multifaceted environment by demonstrating a strong team player skill sets.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to work with data, trackers, and reports.
  • Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and learn structured processes.
  • Good ownership mindset, learning agility, and ability to manage assigned tasks within timelines.
  • Interest in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance, credit control, or business operations.
Opportunity Summary
This apprenticeship provides a strong learning platform for fresh graduates to understand finance operations and Credit Control processes in a global corporate environment. The role is designed to build practical exposure, process discipline, stakeholder communication skills, and a foundation for future career growth in finance and operations.

Entry Level

Our Mission

Fuel customer growth through meaningful, intelligent, and safe user-to-user (and now, user-to-agent) engagement.

CometChat Overview
CometChat is a full-stack conversational platform built to unify every layer of interaction - bringing together real-time conversations (chat, messaging, voice, and video), AI Agents, moderation, notifications, and analytics in one modular, developer-first solution.
Our company has seen rapid growth, thanks to several market validations - including our participation in the Techstars Boulder Accelerator in 2019, followed by investments from experienced investors such as iSeed Ventures, Range Ventures, Silicon Badia, and Matchstick Ventures. CometChat raised a Series A round led by Signal Peak/Run Ventures. In the last 12 months alone, more than 2 billion messages have been sent through our platform.
We were also recognized on Forbes 2026 Americas Top 500 Startup Employers List - a reflection of the team and culture weve been deliberate about building.
We believe the interface of the future is conversation - not clicks. Every app will soon have an AI layer thats as native as text messaging today. Thats why were building the infrastructure for the worlds AI-powered conversations - from human-to-human, to human-to-agent, to multi-party collaboration with AI in the mix.
From AI onboarding assistants that get users productive in minutes, to copilots that perform complex workflows in-app, to intelligent moderators that protect and guide communities in real time - our AI Agent platform makes it all possible.
With CometChats ready-to-use UI kits, powerful SDKs, and our Full Stack AI Agent Platform, product teams across startups and enterprises can launch safe, scalable, and smart in-app interactions faster than ever.
Why Join Us Now
Were at the tipping point where AI becomes a native part of every conversation. At CometChat, youll help shape a future where users can talk to their apps as naturally as to a friend - where agents think, reason, act, and collaborate with humans in real time.
You wont just be joining a product team - youll be building the standard for AI interaction layers: agent-aware UI, intelligent guardrails, rich actions libraries, and multi-party collaboration between people and AI.
If you want to help define how the next billion users will communicate - and push the boundaries of whats possible in real-time, AI-powered engagement - wed love to work with you.
What we mean by AI-native
AI-native here means you build with agents by default. We expect 100% of the code to be generated via agentic tools (Cursor, Claude Code, and similar), while you own everything that actually matters: problem framing, architecture, tradeoffs, review quality, tests, performance, and security. This is not "vibe coding." The code is generated. The thinking is yours. You should be great at steering agents, validating output, catching subtle issues early, and debugging code you did not manually write.
Why AI-native
Software development is changing permanently, and we are leaning all the way in. You will work in a team that ships fast with agents, where your leverage comes from judgment and systems thinking rather than typing speed. You will get access to whatever AI tools you need (Cursor, Claude Code, or anything else that makes you effective), and the freedom to use them aggressively. If you want to operate at the edge of how modern engineering gets done and level up your output, this role is built for that.
Join us to build where AI meets human connection.

Work Location

In our Mumbai (Chembur), India Office.

Position Overview Priorities

Were hiring a Product Manager to own our core product surface the chat, calls, moderation, and AI Agent (Bring Your Own Agent) capabilities that most CometChat customers use today.

This is a growth-stage operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. The product is mature, the customers are real, and the revenue is meaningful. Your job is to grow it through better, faster, and bigger versions of what works, plus new capabilities that expand the product.

Youll own:
  • Roadmap across Chat, Calls, Moderation, and AI Agents (BYOA)
  • New feature development to drive product growth identifying high-leverage opportunities, scoping and shipping capabilities that expand what customers can build with CometChat
  • Backlog prioritization turning hundreds of customer requests, bug reports, and ideas into a coherent shipping plan
  • Customer-facing communication release notes, Feature updates, changelog posts, and the occasional difficult message about timelines
  • Cross-functional partnership with engineering leads across web, mobile, and calling teams; design; and our GTM teams
  • Competitive positioning

jobDescription:
About the Role

We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines.

This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss.

What Youll Do

  • Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided
  • Independently verify whether the golden answer is correct based on the image
  • Identify and flag incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent answersa
  • Provide clear, constructive feedback or corrections to help maintain overall data quality
  • Track recurring error patterns and report them to the project team
  • Ensure Trainer output meets the projects quality bar before final sign-off
  • Escalate unclear cases (e.g., illegible images, ambiguous questions) to the project team for resolution

What Were Looking For

  • Native/Strong proficiency at Bengali
  • Bachelors degree required
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong quality mindset
  • Good visual observation and reading comprehension skills
  • Ability to apply guidelines/rubrics consistently and objectively
  • Strong written English communication skills, especially for giving feedback
  • Prior experience in quality assurance, quality control, editing, proofreading, or data review is a plus
  • Reliable access to a computer and internet connection

Work Format Compensation

  • Work Type: freelance, remote
  • Hours/Schedule: 10 hours per week
  • Compensation: $19.8 /hr
  • Duration: Long-term

What we're looking for


We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent agent systems that power these workflows. This role involves working across the full lifecycle of AI product development - from problem definition and model selection to system architecture, deployment, and continuous optimization.


The AI Engineer will collaborate closely with product, sales, and leadership teams to translate real-world business problems into scalable AI solutions. The role requires strong technical depth in machine learning, LLMs, and system design, along with the ability to evaluate performance, ensure reliability, and iterate rapidly based on user feedback.


This is a high-impact role for someone who can combine engineering rigor with practical problem-solving to build production-grade AI systems and contribute to Automatans core product and long-term technology vision.


Responsibilities

1. AI Systems, Agentic Workflows & LLM Applications

  • Design, develop, and optimize advanced Agentic AI systems and multi-agent architectures for complex business workflows.
  • Manage scalable AI infrastructure across cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • Build intelligent agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, enabling reasoning, task execution, tool usage, and cross-agent coordination.
  • Develop and enhance LLM-powered applications for use cases including document analysis, summarization, classification, workflow automation, hiring, sales, and operations.
  • Apply advanced prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and feedback loops to improve output quality, consistency, and reliability.
  • Research, evaluate, and implement state-of-the-art open-source models such as LLaMA, Qwen, and emerging foundation model architectures.
  • Deploy, monitor, maintain, and continuously improve AI/ML systems in production environments.

2. Retrieval, Model Serving & AI Infrastructure

  • Design, build, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for high-accuracy, context-aware AI experiences.
  • Manage end-to-end retrieval pipelines including data ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector storage, similarity search, and query optimization.
  • Work with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, and related retrieval technologies to improve relevance, latency, and scalability.
  • Integrate LLM APIs, external tools, and enterprise systems into AI applications to enable dynamic, tool-augmented workflows.
  • Deploy, serve, and optimize open-source models using frameworks such as vLLM and Text Generation Inference (TGI), ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

3. Backend Engineering, APIs & Production Systems

  • Develop scalable Python-based backend services, microservices, and RESTful APIs for AI applications and model orchestration.
  • Build robust systems for model serving, workflow execution, and seamless integration with external applications.
  • Ensure modular, reusable, maintainable, and production-grade code architecture across AI platforms.
  • Optimize application performance, fault tolerance, observability, logging, and operational reliability.

4. Scalability & Technical Leadership

  • Implement best practices for CI/CD, model versioning, experimentation, monitoring, and performance tracking.
  • Collaborate closely with product, sales, leadership, and customer-facing teams to translate business requirements into AI solutions.

  • Business Product Collaboration: Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases, market context, and business objectives before diving into technical implementation

  • Write clean, testable Elixir code following OTP and Phoenix conventions
  • Build interactive, real-time UI where needed using Phoenix LiveView
  • Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and query performance with business scalability in mind
  • Build and extend APIs (GraphQL/REST via AshGraphql/AshJsonApi or Phoenix controllers) that serve real production traffic
  • AI Advanced Features: Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) and vector databases into product features (semantic search, embeddings, retrieval-based workflows)
  • Use AI coding assistants effectively to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality
  • Understand the business implications of AI-powered features and their impact on user experience and product strategy
  • Operations Ownership: Instrument features with product analytics (PostHog) to track usage and inform iteration
  • Maintain Docker-based dev containers for a consistent, reproducible local development setup
  • Deploy, monitor, and scale services on Fly.io
  • Own features end-to-end: from understanding requirements and business context to deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement
  • Participate in production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning with an eye toward business impact
  • Team Process: Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, product managers, and project leads in a cross-functional environment
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions with a focus on business value
  • Champion clear thinking and ownership mindset within the engineering team

    • What Youll Work On

    • Resource-driven backend architecture using Ash (resources, actions, relationships, policies, calculations, aggregates)
    • Workflow logic, versioning, and multi-step business processes modeled declaratively in Ash
    • Real-time, interactive features built with Phoenix LiveView
    • Vector DB-backed features such as semantic search, embeddings storage, and retrieval-augmented workflows

jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

The mission - Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isnt a traditional SDR role.

Youll own a Target Account List of US-based mid-market and enterprise companies and run the full outbound motion to get the right GRC buyers in front of our Account Executives. Your mission is simple: map the accounts, find the right people, start meaningful conversations, and consistently create pipeline that turns into revenue.

Youll partner closely with an Account Executive carrying a $400K $600K quota, working on enterprise deals averaging $30K $60K ACV. You wont just hand over leads youll stay close to the deals you create, gaining first-hand exposure to how complex enterprise sales are won.

If youre looking for a role that teaches you how to think like an enterprise seller and not just book meetings, this is where that journey begins.

Where Youll Leave Your Mark

  • Master enterprise account strategy - Before the first cold call, youll map buying committees, understand stakeholder priorities, and identify the right path into every account. Youll develop the strategic account-planning skills that form the foundation of every great enterprise seller.
  • Build pipeline that fuels revenue - Your outbound motion calls, emails, LinkedIn, webinars, and creative outreach will generate qualified conversations that move deals forward. Youll be measured on business impact, not just activity, and learn what it takes to consistently create revenue opportunities.
  • Own a pipeline from day one - Youll create and manage a disciplined outbound motion across a 30 60 day sales cycle, building the resilience, consistency, and commercial judgment needed to succeed in enterprise sales.
  • Build AI-powered outbound systems - We expect you to experiment with AI, automation, and smarter ways of working. The workflows, playbooks, and systems you build wont just make you more effective theyll become part of how Sprinto scales outbound, and a portfolio of work youll carry throughout your career.
  • Learn one seat away from closing - By partnering closely with experienced AEs, youll see how enterprise deals are navigated from first conversation to signed customer. For people who aspire to become Account Executives, this role is designed as a launchpad not a stop.

The Kind of Builder Were Looking For -

  • Youve spent the last 1 3 years sharpening your outbound craft and are now looking for a role that teaches you how enterprise sales is really won.
  • The phone is your first instinct, not your last resort. You enjoy real conversations and know that trust is built one call at a time.
  • You research before you reach out. Understanding the business, the buyer, and the context matters more to you than simply increasing activity.
  • Youve already experimented with AI, automation, prospecting tools, or outbound workflows because youre always looking for smarter ways to work not just harder ones.
  • Youre naturally curious in conversations. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and enjoy uncovering what really matters to buyers.
  • You bring consistency to your work. Whether its prospecting, follow-ups, or pipeline hygiene, you know great outbound is built through discipline, not bursts of effort.
  • Youre excited by enterprise sales and understand that earning the attention of senior buyers takes patience, preparation, and persistence not just great messaging.
  • You enjoy working closely with Account Executives and want to understand what happens after the meeting is booked because your ambition is bigger than simply generating pipeline.

You will enjoy Sprinto if -

  • Stepping in before someone has to step up.
  • Wearing multiple hats without counting them.
  • Leaving egos at the door and winning as one team.
  • Taking the harder right over the easier wrong.
  • Shipping, learning, repeating.
  • Staying curious and never staying in your lane.

Inclusion Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create.

jobDescription:
Digital Marketing Specialist Social Media & Performance Marketing

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content, boosting posts, or increasing followers.

We need someone who understands why people stop, watch, engage, enquire and eventually become customers.

Your job will be to combine Content + Consumer Psychology + Data + Paid Advertising to grow our social media presence and generate quality leads.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Build and execute our Instagram, Facebook and YouTube growth strategy
  • Plan content calendars with the creative team
  • Identify content topics based on audience interests, search behaviour and market trends
  • Work closely with videographers, editors and content creators
  • Analyse which Reels/videos are performing and why
  • Improve hooks, thumbnails, captions, CTAs and content positioning
  • Run and optimize Meta Ads & Google Ads
  • Create lead-generation and remarketing campaigns
  • Track leads from Ad Landing Page/WhatsApp Enquiry Conversion
  • Conduct A/B tests on creatives, audiences, hooks and offers
  • Build retargeting audiences
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets
  • Prepare simple weekly/monthly performance reports

The Skills We're Looking For

1. Social Media Strategy

You should understand:

  • Instagram Reels
  • Facebook
  • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
  • Organic content growth
  • Content distribution
  • Audience building
  • Engagement & retention
  • Social-media trends
  • Competitor research

You shouldn't simply tell us:

“This Reel got 50,000 views.”

You should be able to explain:

“Why did it get 50,000 views, where did viewers drop, what made people share it, and how can we repeat that success?”

2. Performance Marketing

Hands-on experience with:

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Facebook & Instagram Ads
  • Google Ads
  • Lead-generation campaigns
  • Conversion campaigns
  • Remarketing
  • Lookalike/custom audiences
  • Campaign budgeting
  • Creative testing
  • A/B testing
  • Cost-per-lead optimization

You should understand metrics such as:

CPL • CTR • CPC • CPM • Conversion Rate • ROAS • CAC

But more importantly, you should understand what action to take when those numbers aren't performing.

3. Analytics

Working knowledge of:

  • Meta Business Suite
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Search Console
  • YouTube Analytics
  • Google Trends
  • Pixel & conversion tracking
  • UTM tracking

We want someone who can turn data into decisions, not simply download reports.

4. Consumer Psychology

This is extremely important for us.

You should be curious about:

Why does someone click?

Why does someone watch one Reel for 3 seconds and another for 40 seconds?

Why does someone save a video but not enquire?

Why does one advertisement generate cheap but poor-quality leads while another generates fewer but serious customers?

Understanding attention, curiosity, trust, objections, desire and buying behaviour will be a major advantage.

Content Marketing

You don't necessarily have to shoot or edit every video.

But you should be able to guide the creative team on:

Topic Hook Content Angle Thumbnail CTA Distribution Retargeting

You should be comfortable telling the team:

“Video achha hai, but opening ke first 3 seconds weak hain. Let's test another hook.”

That's the mindset we're looking for.

Qualification

Degree is preferred. Skills are mandatory.

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in:

  • Digital Marketing
  • Marketing
  • Mass Communication
  • Business/Management
  • Media
  • Advertising

is an advantage, but not compulsory.

Candidates with strong practical knowledge and proven results are encouraged to apply even without a specialized degree.

Experience

1–3 years preferred.

Freshers can also apply if they have exceptional practical knowledge and can demonstrate their work.

Agency experience, personal projects, freelancing or managing your own successful social-media pages will also be considered.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who is:

Analytical + Creative + Curious + Result-Oriented

Someone who doesn't wait for instructions for everything.

If a campaign isn't working, you should naturally want to know:

“Why?”

If a Reel suddenly performs 10X better than usual:

“Why?”

If competitors are growing faster:

“What are they doing differently?”

That curiosity matters to us.

What We DON'T Want

Someone whose entire strategy is:

“Sir, 500 ka boost kar dete hain.”

We are looking for someone who understands the difference between boosting a post and building an actual marketing system.

How to Apply

Please send:

  1. CV
  2. Previous social-media pages/accounts managed
  3. Examples of Meta/Google campaigns you've handled
  4. Any measurable results you've achieved
  5. Tools you're comfortable using
  6. Current location
  7. Current/Last salary
  8. Expected salary

Work Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

Our Goal

We aren't looking for someone simply to manage our social media.

We want someone who can help us understand our audience better, build authority through content, generate qualified enquiries and continuously improve results through experimentation and data.Role & responsibilities
